title: UNHRDB — UN Human Rights Database
description: Open-source paragraph-level research environment for UN human rights law. UNHRDB combines Treaty Body General Comments and Recommendations, individual-communication jurisprudence, and thematic Special Procedures reports in a source-first interface with faceted search, citation export, document workspaces, and extractive retrieval. The software and curated datasets have separate licences; see LICENSE, LICENSE-DATA, and NOTICE in the repository. The v2.1.0 release (3 September 2026) covers 6,112 documents and 322,683 paragraphs: 187 General Comments and Recommendations, 4,333 individual-communication decisions from 8 treaty bodies, and 1,592 thematic Special Procedures reports from all 46 mandates.
